svg.aria-label: Lenz law for a magnet and a ring in four cases: the induced current always makes a field that opposes the change in flux, so an approaching pole is repelled and a receding pole is attracted
svg.text: Lenz: the induced current always fights the change, never the flux itself

text.tspan: Lenz’s law — induced current, induced field and the force on the magnet in four cases
